name: DataGrid
description: Interactive data grid for large or server-driven datasets: multi-sort, filters, search, selection, paging, hidden and pinned columns, and row virtualization.

props.caption: string
props.columns: { key: string; label: string; render: (row: T) => ReactNode; align?: start | end; sortable?: boolean; sortValue?: (row: T) => string | number | Date | null; filter?: text | { options: { value: string; label: string }[] }; filterValue?: (row: T) => string | number | null; hideable?: boolean; width?: string; truncate?: boolean; priority?: high | medium | low; pin?: start | end }[]
props.rows: T[] where T extends { id: string } (every row in client mode; the current page in server mode)
props.rowCount: number (total matching rows; required in server mode)
props.sort: { key: string; direction: ascending | descending }[] (controlled sort levels)
props.filters: Record<string, string> (column key to filter value)
props.selectedIds: string[] (may include rows that are not loaded; select all adds every matching row in client mode, the loaded page in server mode)
props.pagination: { page: number; pageSize: number } (pages rows when set)
props.virtualize: boolean (renders only the rows in view)
props.estimateRowHeight: number (pixels used until the first row is measured; default 44)
props.toolbar: ReactNode (after the built-in search and filters)
props.empty: { title: string; description?: string; action?: ReactNode } (no rows at all)
props.noResults: { title: string; description?: string } (search or filters match nothing)
props.noun: string (plural noun for counts; default rows)

contract.usage: Import { DataGrid } from @tonycodes-ui/mortar/data-grid and install the optional peer dependencies @tanstack/react-table and @tanstack/react-virtual. Use DataTable for a few hundred rows or fewer; use DataGrid for large sets, server-driven data or when people need filters, multi-sort, hidden or pinned columns. Client mode sorts, filters, searches and pages in the browser; server mode only reports state changes, so pass the matching page of rows and rowCount. Shift-click a header to add a sort level. Pair virtualize with maxHeight for thousands of rows; give columns a filter to put a control in the toolbar.
contract.avoid: Do not import TanStack Table yourself to style a table, copy implementations, override central colours or grant component approval.
contract.accessibility: Verify accessible names, keyboard interaction, visible focus, responsive layout and supported states. Virtualized grids set aria-rowcount and aria-rowindex; the status region announces matching counts.
